name: confirm-dialog
title: Confirm Dialog
description: UI SDK AlertDialog with an async confirm action: pending, no double submit, closes on success, inline error on failure, data-agent-confirm for destructive actions.
docs: `<ConfirmDialog trigger title description confirmLabel onConfirm>`: a returned Promise keeps it open and pending, a rejection shows its message (`renderError`). `tone="destructive"` requires `agentConfirm`. Children render as a callout under the description, an Alert in the dialog's tone (`destructive`, or `info` for the default tone; `calloutTone` overrides) that screen readers hear with the description. `labels={{ cancel }}` names the cancel button, "Cancel" by default; `cancelLabel` is deprecated. `triggerDisabled` stops the trigger and `triggerPending` shows `Button loading`'s spinner with `aria-busy` while the trigger keeps focus, for work already running; while either is set the dialog refuses to open, an agent's `setOpen` included.
